decisions.reason: It is close to the firm’s utility- and infrastructure-oriented fabrication capabilities, so in a growing industry management is likely to give this adjacent product more time unless results clearly disappoint.

Public waste bins are the most distant from the firm’s established offer and are likely to face tougher price-based competition, so if early sales fall short of aspiration the firm would reallocate resources to more related products.
Ground sleeves fit the firm’s metalworking, coating and contractor-facing strengths, and as a small product line they are likely to be retained while management tests market acceptance.

Cast iron ground sleeves are related to the new ground-sleeve push but somewhat less aligned with the firm’s steel-processing core, so they carry a higher pruning risk yet are still more likely to be kept for now.
Steel ground sleeves match the firm’s stated steel-processing expertise especially well, making them the most natural extension and the least likely to be withdrawn quickly.
